measurement_note: Size is n, the node count. Each tier is a complete full tree whose internal nodes are AND and whose leaves are true, forcing every subtree to be evaluated and producing true. Postorder evaluation is linear in n. A correct implementation that repeatedly searches a collected node order for every processed node completes all tiers but is quadratic.
